jobDescription:
We are seeking two Account Executives to manage our government contract bidding clients across India. The Account Executive will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of accounts and will be responsible for renewals, issue resolution, client communication, and identifying cross-sell opportunities. This role is suited for someone comfortable with data-heavy technical products, confident over calls and email, and able to build lasting relationships with traditional SME and enterprise clients. As the team grows, the role will shift toward ownership of account relationships, negotiations, and mentoring new joinees while routine support and follow-up tasks are gradually handed over.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own renewals for an assigned portfolio of government contract bidding clients across India. Act as the primary contact for client communication over calls, email, Whats App, and meetings. Understand client usage, resolve issues, coordinate internally, and ensure timely follow-through. Identify cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts and support renewals and expansion conversations. Maintain accurate account notes, renewal status, client context, and follow-up plans in the internal tracking system. Develop toward account ownership, negotiation, and mentoring newer team members as the function scales. Requirements: Graduation is mandatory. MBA is mandatory. Minimum 2+ years of experience in a technology company is mandatory. The 2 years of technology-company experience may be before MBA or after MBA. Relevant experience in account management, customer success, renewals, sales, client support, or product support is preferred. Strong spoken and written communication skills, with comfort handling traditional SME and enterprise clients. Ability to understand data-heavy technical products and explain value clearly to clients. Must be available to work on-site from Indiranagar, Bengaluru. Perks: Portfolio ownership with direct exposure to clients across India. Growth path into account ownership, renewal negotiations, expansion revenue, and team mentoring.

title: Data Engineering Intern
requiredSkills: Currently pursuing or recently completed a B.Tech in Computer Science or a related field.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Comfort working with data - cleaning, transforming, and analysing large datasets (e.g. pandas, SQL).
Basic understanding of PostgreSQL or relational databases.
Familiarity with web scraping, APIs, or data-processing tools is a strong plus.
Exposure to Linux environments.
Genuine interest in data engineering, pipelines, and AI/ML data workflows.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
jobDescription:
A 6-month, in-office internship building Palladium
- the data + AI platform trusted by hundreds of mid-to-large Indian enterprises. You'll work directly with the founders and engineering team to acquire, clean, and process large-scale data that powers intelligent search and decision-making. Core work: web scraping and API reverse-engineering, Python data pipelines, Postgre SQL, and preparing data for AI/ML workflows.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build crawlers and scrapers (e.g. with Selenium) and reverse-engineer web APIs to acquire data at scale. Design and build Python data pipelines to extract, clean, transform, and process large, messy datasets. Model and query data in Postgre SQL
- schema design, optimization, and handling large tables. Prepare and structure datasets that feed machine-learning models and AI-driven analytics. Instrument data quality and reliability across ingestion and processing. Deploy and run pipelines on Linux servers, and support monitoring and uptime. Work closely with founders and engineers to turn raw data into product features used by Indian enterprises. Requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed a B.Tech in Computer Science or a related field. Strong programming skills in Python. Comfort working with data
- cleaning, transforming, and analysing large datasets (e.g. pandas, SQL). Basic understanding of Postgre SQL or relational databases. Familiarity with web scraping, APIs, or data-processing tools is a strong plus. Exposure to Linux environments. Genuine interest in data engineering, pipelines, and AI/ML data workflows. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Perks: Hands-on experience building production data pipelines and infrastructure. Work with large-scale, real-world datasets from across India's economy. Exposure to AI/ML data workflows and intelligent data products. Work directly with the founders in a fast-growing Saa S startup. Build technology used by leading Indian enterprises.

jobDescription:
Drive enterprise sales for Primenumbers' AI business-intelligence platform
- owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close. You'll engage senior stakeholders (VPs, CXOs, and Heads of Department) and thrive in a fast-paced B2B Saa S environment. 5 days onsite | 2-4 years experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Drive new customer acquisition through outbound channels
- cold calling, email campaigns, and Linked In outreach. Identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers (VPs, CXOs, and Heads of Department). Conduct impactful product demonstrations and articulate value propositions effectively. Understand client business challenges and tailor solutions accordingly. Manage the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation to closure. Maintain accurate pipeline tracking and ensure consistent follow-ups. Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets and KPIs. Leverage internal tools and data sources to identify high-potential prospects. Requirements: 2-4 years of experience in outbound/inside sales, preferably in Saa S, IT, or technology sales. Strong communication and presentation skills in English and Hindi. Proven B2B sales experience and understanding of sales cycles. Ability to work in a target-driven, high-performance environment. Strong negotiation, problem-solving, and relationship-building skills. Bachelor's degree (preferred in BTech, BE, BCA, BSc, or related fields). Perks: Sell a high-impact, AI-powered product with strong market relevance. Fast-paced environment with high ownership and learning opportunities. Direct exposure to enterprise clients and senior stakeholders. Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives. Clear career progression in a rapidly growing organization.
